note: City of Anthony's 153-acre lake 1 mi NW of town. Four RV camping areas: A (33 sites) and B (22, on the peninsula) on the east side by the stage, restrooms, showerhouse and boat ramp; C (18) on the west shore by the golf course; D (1 site, no water) 0.75 mi north. Every site is 30 A or 30/50 A with shared water hookups; no sewer; dump station south of the dam. Tent camping in the unimproved areas. Showerhouse replacement planned for 2027. --Claude
summary: City page + Campspot: $15 confirmed (Campspot shows $18.55 with fees); now reservable on Campspot (was FCFS only); 74 RV sites (66 -> 74), 50 A confirmed, water confirmed, sewer cleared (no page lists it), showers/dump/water/wifi; 14-night summer max, year-round. Lakefront -> lakeview. C and D are not split candidates. New phone.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview: every area's own road or drive sits between the sites and the water. A (imagery 2026-11-06, 150 m frame): the sites run in rows inside the loop, with the campground's dirt road, then the walking path and riprap, between them and the west shore, 40-60 m. B (peninsula): the gravel pull-through rows sit inside the peninsula loop; the north row is about 25-40 m from the shore across grass crossed by a thin path. I couldn't tell whether that path is the concrete walking trail or a drive, so I went down. C (west shore): sites spread through open grass between W Deer Creek Trail and the lake, with a dirt track running along the shoreline itself. B's north row is the one lakefront lead worth a closer look.

SPLIT: not a candidate. C is about 290 m from A straight across the lake (A about 37.1750,-98.0500; C about 37.1755,-98.0532), under the ~1 km rule, though by road it's about 1 km round via Nine Iron Drive over the dam. D is 0.75 mi north but has a single site (D1, 30/50 A, no water). Per area: A 33 sites (21 30 A + 12 30/50 A), WiFi, restrooms/showers nearby, view; B 22 sites (all 30/50 A, pull-through rows), view; C 18 sites (8 30 A + 10 30/50 A), its own restrooms and shelters, view; D 1 site.

BOOKING CHANGE: the stored 'reservable: false' is out of date. The city page says 'Visitors can reserve online' and links Campspot (https://www.campspot.com/book/anthonykansas); walk-ups still pay before pulling in.
PHONE (none stored) -> 620-842-5434 (Campspot park record; City of Anthony). Website https://www.anthonykansas.org/community is current (anchor #anthony_lake).
SEWER cleared: the stored sewer true was note-derived; the city page, map and Campspot amenity lists name electric and shared water only.

LONG STAYS: C allows 28 nights in season and there is no limit in the off-season, but all 74 RV sites are sold nightly at $15 on Campspot and were nearly all open on both dates I checked. Not a mostly-seasonal park.

PIN 37.1770,-98.0475 sits on loop B; A's centre is about 37.1750,-98.0500 and the site-weighted centre about 37.1757,-98.0501 (about 270 m away). That's borderline: moving to about 37.1757,-98.0492, between A and B by the stage, is optional. Campspot's park point (37.174366,-98.04907) is at the south end of A.
